I also attend the Weekly istema here and attend the khanqah of a shaykh very much connected to the Ulema of Deoband. I hope the information I provided is helpful in deriving an interpretation of a dream. The question is regarding a dream that I saw a few months ago. I live in Toronto, Canada and I got arrested by the police and then they took me in to prison. Upon arriving in my jail cell, I immediately realized there is no path now other then to to turn to Allah. I prayed and prayed on my Jainamaz within the jail cell and eventually got released. Can you tell me meaning of this? 1589 views Q. My wife saw a dream and I would like the tabir of the dream, please. She saw our son M.Zahid (4 years old)inside a well and he is wearing a white topi. My wife goes in the well to save him and picks him with one hand, and the water in the well was dirty (matyala). Jazzak Allahu Kheir, remember us in your Dua's. 1395 views Q. My new dream that i saw during the month of ramadan after the SEHRI. I saw that i along with my family are on a journey to baitullah in makkah for an OMRA. when we reach there i lose my family and i am looking for them in the mosque. I am carrying luggage of someone and i want to find him and give him his luggage.i look for him in all the haram including inside the main black ka'aba but i dont find him. I think that it is the luggage of my university friend. Everyone is busy in praying and in TAWAF but i am searching for him. i even loose my asr prayer due to our journey to makkah and searching. Someone tell us that it is the time for IFTAR so we break our fast(ROZA). but when i came out and see the sky, it is still day. SO i get very upset for my roza, prayer and the luggage. then i find my family but not the person. In the mean time I get up. PLEASE i am very upset due to this dream because I don't pray there. So please give me the meaning of this dream. 1997 views Q. My Husband passed in an unfortunate accident on 24th Ramadan this year.
